title: Trade-In Agreements Cushion Days on Aged Payoff Quotes
content:
On **Trade-In Agreements**, cushion days are added to the days for which the latest payoff quote's per diem is charged in the customer's shortfall payment. They depend on the latest quote's age on the day of payment, counted in calendar days from its quote date.

| Latest quote's age on the day of payment | Cushion days added |
|---|---|
| 7 days or more | 5 |
| At least 4 days but under 7 days | 3 |
| Under 4 days | None |

## Boundaries

| Age on the day of payment | Cushion days |
|---|---|
| 3 days | None |
| 4 days | 3 |
| 6 days | 3 |
| 7 days | 5 |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A quote dated the 2nd with a per diem of $3.10, paid on the 10th: the quote is 8 days old, so 5 cushion days are added, which is $3.10 multiplied by 5, or $15.50 of per diem added to the shortfall payment. Paid on the 7th, the quote is 5 days old and 3 cushion days add $9.30.
